description: Switch the active organisation for subsequent MCP tool calls (e.g. get_periodic_summaries, query_kpis). The user must be a member and the target org must have an active subscription. The switch applies to this MCP client only, for every agent that uses it. Agents that work in parallel should not switch; they pass organization_id with each tool call instead, which runs that single call in the named organisation and leaves the active one unchanged.

organization_id.description: Tenant ID to switch to. Must appear in list_organizations.

name: switch_organization
